prompt:
A hyper-realistic tilt-shift macro photography video sequence of a miniature historical war and disaster world. Cinematic macro lens, stop-motion diorama aesthetic, 8k resolution, vertical 9:16 aspect ratio. 

Scene 1: Miniature ancient soldiers in muddy trenches holding back a raging, muddy river flood with sandbags; a giant human hand places a large ball of clay to plug a major breach in the dam while the tiny soldiers hold on and sigh in relief. 
Scene 2: Tiny ancient Chinese soldiers in armor resting inside a ruined fort wall under siege with fires in the background; a giant human hand drops miniature chestnuts, a rice dumpling, and a small water pouch into a cracked clay pot, feeding the exhausted soldiers who look up in awe and gratitude. 

Cinematic depth of field, detailed textures, smooth motion --ar 9:16

translations.zh:
微缩历史战争与灾难世界的超逼真移轴微距摄影视频序列。电影级微距镜头，定格微缩模型美学，8k分辨率，9:16竖屏比例。

场景1：泥泞战壕中的微缩古代士兵用沙袋抵御汹涌的泥泞洪流；一只巨大的手放置一个大泥球堵住大坝决口，微缩士兵们坚持住并松了一口气。
场景2：身披铠甲的微缩古代中国士兵在被围困的破损城墙内休息，背景有战火；一只巨大的手将微缩栗子、粽子和小水袋放入破损陶罐中，给疲惫的士兵喂食，他们敬畏感激地仰望。

电影级景深，细节质感，平滑动作 --ar 9:16
